items.title: Carrier Global (NYSE:CARR) Surprises With Strong Q2 CY2026, Guides for Strong Full-Year Sales
items.summary: Heating, ventilation, air conditioning, and refrigeration company Carrier Global (NYSE:CARR) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 3.9% year on year to $6.35 billion. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $23 billion at the midpoint came in 3.1% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.86 per share was 5.2% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
